subject: scripts/db-inventory.mjs

steps.name: the migration chain builds the disposable schema from nothing
the tool reads a live server and calls a chain-built database a match
every statement the tool sent is a read
the credential appears in nothing the tool writes or prints
the tool refuses an owner role until --allow-owner is passed
the tool refuses a report path outside docs
a column that no migration created is reported as drift
a table that no migration created is reported as extra
a table the chain requires and the live database lacks is reported as missing
the tool leaves the schema it reads exactly as it found it
the row level security picture the hosted run depends on is produced
the three seeded differences are the whole of what it reports

columnDrift.name: qa_drift_column
columnDrift.problem: present in the live database but created by no migration file

reading: PASS here means the instrument works against a live PostgreSQL server, reads only, keeps the credential out of its report, and detects drift in both directions and a table count that does not match the chain. It does not mean the hosted beta database matches the chain. That run needs the founder, a read-only role and the same command: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/db-inventory.mjs --out docs/readiness/beta/db-inventory.json
disclosure: the disposable cluster this file owns listens on a loopback port and is destroyed before this receipt is written. Its secret never left the process environment; the report on disk carries host, port, database and role name only, and the per-case reports are removed once their finding is recorded here.
